description: 3-stage mass assignment via in-memory user displayPrefs merge: (1) add displayPrefs object to userDB entries + GET /sso/user/displayPrefs endpoint, (2) add PUT /sso/user/displayPrefs that merges via Object.assign into a local variable but forgets to assign back to user.displayPrefs -- changes don't persist, (3) fix by assigning merged result back: user.displayPrefs = merged -- now arbitrary user-controlled JSON persists including role/isAdmin fields.
